title: Save and load the player
description:
Write the player part of Delve's save format.

`savePlayer(p)` returns the text, one line per fact, each ending in `\n`:

```
player X Y hp HEALTH MAXHEALTH power POWER armour ARMOUR
inv ID COUNT          (one line per inventory entry, in order)
```

`loadPlayer(text)` reads it back. It must accept the lines in any order, ignore blank lines and lines whose keyword it does not know (a newer version may have added some), and return `std::nullopt` if the `player` line is missing or malformed (wrong number of fields, wrong labels, or non-numbers), or an `inv` line is malformed or has a count below 1.

```
savePlayer({ 7, 4, 14, 20, 4, 1, { { "potion", 3 }, { "dagger", 1 } } })
  == "player 7 4 hp 14 20 power 4 armour 1\ninv potion 3\ninv dagger 1\n"
```
hints: Write with an `std::ostringstream`. Read line by line, and parse each line with its own `std::istringstream`: read the keyword, then the fields with `>>`. If any `>>` fails, the stream's condition is false.
Read the labels (`hp`, `power`, `armour`) into strings and check them. After the expected fields, a further successful `>>` means there was something extra on the line.
